headline: The backend spike now has measurable acceptance checks.
copy: Every useful backend step must keep citation, family, confidence, reviewer state, rights state, boundary, and no-source behavior intact.

postures.copy: Oppenheimer returns Bhagavad Gita 11.32 with category boundary.

postures.title: UI links

flow.copy: Check every new script before execution.

flow.title: API
flow.copy: Start and stop the server inside the test.

flow.title: Evidence

decisions.label: Required fields
decisions.reason: Trace, query, source, citation, family, confidence, states, boundary, and next action.

decisions.label: No-source
decisions.reason: Unsupported modern claims must refuse politely.

decisions.label: Fixture regression

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No live model call is enabled by this release.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable user, reviewer, telemetry, or account storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No licensed source text delivery is assumed.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: VedaPath remains source-backed study and reflection support, not a guru or clinician.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: A passing local contract is not production reliability, security, or rights approval.
